about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Adelita S. Grijalva

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DETERIORATING CONDITIONS AT ELOY DETENTION CENTER
statements.title: DETERIORATING CONDITIONS AT ELOY DETENTION CENTER
sentences: My office has received multiple reports from family members of people in detention, and their lawyers, that detainees are being denied access to proper drinking water.
Her wife told her that the detainees are only being given ice chips for water, which they have to wait until they melt.
I am calling on DHS to immediately address these conditions and ensure that all detainees have access to safe drinking water, edible food, and humane living conditions. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING DOMESTIC MINING ACT OF 2025
statements.title: PROTECTING DOMESTIC MINING ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in opposition of H.R. 1501, the Protecting Domestic Mining Act.
For those reasons, Mr. Speaker, I oppose H.R. 1501, and urge my colleagues to do the same.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GIVING VOICE TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION PRINCIPLES
statements.title: GIVING VOICE TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION PRINCIPLES
sentences: In southern Arizona--from Tucson to Nogales, Yuma, Avondale, Tolleson, Douglas, and our border and travel communities--the impact is deeply personal.
In border and rural communities where healthcare deserts are a reality, rolling back health equity initiatives means leaving mothers, children, and our most vulnerable neighbors behind.
They are weaponizing independent watchdogs, with the FCC ordering a review of ABC's broadcast licenses over its diversity and inclusion policies.
When this administration rolls back protections for people with disabilities, strips LGBTQ+ protections, or targets women's medical research, it is not simply streamlining government.
It is unravelling the public infrastructure of our democracy, because diversity, equity, and inclusion are not buzz words.
We will not sit in silence while 60 years of civil rights progress are erased by an executive decree.
I urge my colleagues and the American people to see this campaign for what it is: a systemic dismantling of our civil rights.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LIBERTY AND JUSTICE FOR ALL
statements.title: LIBERTY AND JUSTICE FOR ALL
sentences: Earlier this year, Emmanuel Damas, a Haitian asylum seeker, died after being held in ICE custody at the Florence detention facility in Arizona.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HATE HAS NO PLACE HERE
statements.title: HATE HAS NO PLACE HERE
sentences: The House of Representatives is returning to session this week, and our first action should be passing commonsense gun safety reforms that we know can save lives.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: THE UNITED STATES REPRESENTS HOPEFUL NEW BEGINNINGS
statements.title: THE UNITED STATES REPRESENTS HOPEFUL NEW BEGINNINGS
sentences: I am the daughter of a Member of Congress, who spent his life fighting for immigrants and working families.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FIGHTING BACK AGAINST DISMANTLING OF VOTING RIGHTS
statements.title: FIGHTING BACK AGAINST DISMANTLING OF VOTING RIGHTS
sentences: This is why the Supreme Court's decision in Louisiana v. Callais is so alarming.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PARENTAL RIGHTS OVER THE EDUCATION AND CARE OF THEIR KIDS ACT
statements.title: PARENTAL RIGHTS OVER THE EDUCATION AND CARE OF THEIR KIDS ACT
sentences: This bill forces teachers to out transgender students to their own parents even when they know it could put that child at risk of abuse, homelessness, or violence.
This bill censors discussions about transgender people and gender identity altogether.
It is time to stop scapegoating children, stop targeting our kids, stop obsessing about gender identity, and let's start doing the jobs that people actually sent us here to do.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in opposition to H.R. 2616.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``no'' on H.R. 2616.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMMEMORATING ANNIVERSARY AND SACRIFICE OF OFFICER JOHN ANTHONY VALENZUELA
statements.title: COMMEMORATING ANNIVERSARY AND SACRIFICE OF OFFICER JOHN ANTHONY VALENZUELA
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to commemorate the anniversary of the sacrifice of fallen officer John Anthony Valenzuela of the South Tucson Police Department, who was killed in the line of duty on May 17, 1993.
He is the only officer killed in the line of duty in the history of the South Tucson Police Department.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: 2027 PRESIDENTIAL BUDGET REQUEST WILL MAKE LIFE HARDER
statements.title: 2027 PRESIDENTIAL BUDGET REQUEST WILL MAKE LIFE HARDER
sentences: While working families struggle to get by, this budget spends $350 billion on another endless and illegal war abroad.
It slashes affordable housing programs like CDBG.

I will not support a budget that asks working families to sacrifice more just to bankroll endless wars abroad and hand out tax breaks to the wealthy. ``Our people deserve better''; ``nuestra gente merece mejor.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REDUCING AND ELIMINATING DUPLICATIVE ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATIONS ACT
statements.title: REDUCING AND ELIMINATING DUPLICATIVE ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATIONS ACT
sentences: I will make this crystal clear: Our constituents do not want to increase the risks of their children developing asthma or cancer so that billionaires can fast-track polluting projects.
As a parent, I can tell you, we will not stand for putting polluters over our children's right to breathe in clean air.

Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to insert the text of my amendment into the Record immediately prior to the vote on the motion to recommit, and I urge my colleagues to support the motion to recommit.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MAKING LIFE MORE AFFORDABLE
statements.title: MAKING LIFE MORE AFFORDABLE
sentences: Working families are struggling to get by.
Instead of relief, they are being ignored, all while Trump and House Republicans continue to serve their billionaire friends and special interests.

That kind of investment could have provided Medicaid to over 6 million children, funded head start for 1.3 million families, canceled $20,000 in student debt for 1 million borrowers, or funded the ACA premium assistance that Republicans refused to extend.
Instead of putting billionaires first, Congress should focus on policies that make people's lives better.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CRITICAL MINERAL DOMINANCE ACT
statements.title: CRITICAL MINERAL DOMINANCE ACT
sentences: Through the Save Oak Flat from Foreign Mining Act, I seek to reverse the giveaway of publicly owned land and the natural resources beneath it to this foreign mining conglomerate.
Mr. Speaker, I strongly oppose H.R. 4090.
Mr. Speaker, I urge strong opposition to H.R. 4090.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HORRIFIC ICE ABUSES
statements.title: HORRIFIC ICE ABUSES
sentences: Let's be clear: Border communities are not war zones.
Border towns, like Nogales, which I represent in Congress, are vibrant, binational communities where families live, work, and thrive.
Instead of listening to local leaders, this administration keeps choosing militarization, fear mongering, and political theater, and it is costing people their lives.
On January 7, an ICE agent murdered Renee Good, an unarmed U.S. citizen, in Minneapolis.
For border communities, this violence is not new.
In 2012, 16-year- old Jose Antonio Elena Rodriguez was shot and killed by Border Patrol through a border fence while he was walking home on the Mexico side of the border in Nogales, Sonora.
ICE has already been handed $75 billion through the Republican's big, ugly bill, money that was ripped away from SNAP, Medicaid, and working families.
I will not rubberstamp an agency that enables violence, racial profiling, and terror in our neighborhoods.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REWRITING HISTORY
statements.title: REWRITING HISTORY
sentences: That is why the recent removal of the interpretive materials titled ``Life Under Slavery,'' ``The Dirty Business of Slavery,'' and signage addressing climate change should alarm every American.
They are histories that make some people uncomfortable, but discomfort is not a justification for censorship.
Instead, we are fighting simply to ensure that these public lands continue to represent the full dimension of the American experience.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOP THE REPUBLICAN AFFORDABILITY CRISIS
statements.title: STOP THE REPUBLICAN AFFORDABILITY CRISIS
sentences: I want to drive housing prices up. . . .'' That tells us exactly whom he is fighting for: Wall Street speculators and billionaires, not our families living on Main Streets and in our barrios.
This administration canceled clean energy projects that could have powered 13 million homes, destroying 165,000 jobs in the process.
Rising costs, shrinking safety nets, and tax breaks for billionaires are all at the expense of working families.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESTORING ELECTION INTEGRITY
statements.title: RESTORING ELECTION INTEGRITY
sentences: Mr. Speaker, 16 years ago today, the Supreme Court's Citizens United decision opened the floodgates to unlimited corporate and billionaire spending in our elections, drowning out the voices of working people.
The decision overturned longstanding precedent rooted on independent political spending by corporations and billionaires.

The conservative majority embraced the idea that spending money on elections equals speech and that corporations are entitled to the same speech rights as people, giving carte blanche to corporations and billionaires to spend unlimited money.
Private prison and immigrant detention contractors spend millions to influence elections and policy, all while people die in their facilities.

Fossil fuel and mining companies pour enormous sums into elections to block climate action while communities like mine in Arizona face record heat, drought, and wildfires and continue to deal with the devastating impact to our water, land, and environment.

The gun lobby spends millions to stop lifesaving reforms while my friend Congresswoman Gabby Giffords continues to fight for commonsense gun laws so that tragedies like that mass shooting in Tucson never happen again.
Ultimately, we need to pass a constitutional amendment reversing Citizens United.
Mr. Speaker, 16 years after Citizens United, we need to shift the power back to everyday Americans and away from those who can write the biggest checks.
It is past time that we reverse course on Citizens United.
It is time to act and end Citizens United.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING EDUCATION FOR CHILDREN WITH DISABILITIES
statements.title: PROTECTING EDUCATION FOR CHILDREN WITH DISABILITIES
sentences: I urge my colleagues to reject the efforts to weaken IDEA or dismantle the Department of Education.
I will continue to stand with students, families, educators, and advocates, and I call on this body to do the same.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING HEALTHCARE FOR MILLIONS OF AMERICANS
statements.title: PROTECTING HEALTHCARE FOR MILLIONS OF AMERICANS
sentences: Millions of Americans who depend on the Affordable Care Act are selecting their plans right now, and what they are seeing are healthcare options that they cannot afford due to Republicans' refusal to extend premium assistance.
Over 10 million people will lose their Medicaid, and now millions more could lose their health coverage because they can't afford their premiums.
The State of Arizona has estimated the impact of Medicaid cuts alone to be $34 billion over the next 10 years.
His employer does not provide insurance, and he makes too much money to qualify for Medicaid.
Americans have had enough of cutting programs that Americans need for basic survival, enough of the attempts to repeal the Affordable Care Act, enough Republicans' skyrocketing costs.
I urge the Senate to act immediately and take up the premium extension bill passed by the House.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LOWER HEALTH CARE PREMIUMS FOR ALL AMERICANS ACT
statements.title: LOWER HEALTH CARE PREMIUMS FOR ALL AMERICANS ACT
sentences: Allowing premiums to skyrocket, enacting a backdoor abortion ban, and allowing plans to not cover things like maternity care and preexisting conditions is not a solution.
Mr. Speaker, first and foremost, I will state that nobody should ever be denied basic healthcare, period.
Mr. Speaker, I urge a ``no'' vote on this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FIGHTING DHS IMMIGRATION RAIDS
statements.title: FIGHTING DHS IMMIGRATION RAIDS
sentences: In border communities like the one I represent in Arizona's Seventh Congressional District, we see the impact of these abuses every single day.
We have seen Border Patrol waiting outside of hospitals, literally arresting women after they have given birth--no due process, no regard for human rights.

Humanitarian volunteers with No More Deaths reported that Border Patrol agents forced their way into their desert aid station known as Byrd Camp, without a warrant and arrested three migrants who were resting inside a trailer.
More than 4,400 men, women, and children have died crossing the border in Arizona since 2000.
It was lawless, intentional, and part of a broader pattern of unchecked enforcement that treats border communities as if the Constitution does not apply.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EPSTEIN FILES TRANSPARENCY ACT
statements.title: EPSTEIN FILES TRANSPARENCY ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on the Epstein File Transparency Act. ____________________
